import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, overlaps, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_two_events():
    """Events may arrive in any order and gaps are sorted by start."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 720=12*60, 780=13*60, 1020=17*60
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_overlapping_contained_event():
    """Events may overlap each other and overlapping busy time is merged."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    expected = [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_clipped_start_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 550)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(550, 1020)]  # 400=6*60+40, 480=8*60, 550=9*60+10, 1020=17*60, clipped busy is 480-550
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_clipped_end_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(900, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 900)]  # 480=8*60, 900=15*60, 1020=17*60, 1100=18*60+20, clipped busy is 900-1020
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_ignored_touching_outside_day():
    """Events entirely outside the day leave the whole day free."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 480), Event(1020, 1200)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 1020)]  # 0=0, 480=8*60, 1020=17*60, 1200=20*60, both touch but share no minute
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_overlapping_chain_unsorted():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(650, 750), Event(540, 620), Event(600, 680)], 480, 800)
    expected = [(480, 540), (750, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 750=12*60+30, 800=13*60+20, merged busy is 540-750
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_events_returns_whole_day():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 1020=17*60, gap length 1020-480=540
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_min_minutes_filters_small_gap():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(610, 700)], 480, 800, min_minutes=11)
    expected = [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 610=10*60+10, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20; middle gap 610-600=10 < 11
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_min_minutes_exact_threshold_kept():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(610, 700)], 480, 800, min_minutes=10)
    expected = [(480, 540), (600, 610), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 610=10*60+10, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20; middle gap 610-600=10 >= 10
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_back_to_back_leaves_no_gap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    result = free_slots([Event(480, 540), Event(540, 600)], 480, 720)
    expected = [(600, 720)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 720=12*60, no gap between 540 and 540
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_overlaps_shared_minute():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)) is True  # share 650-600=50 minutes from 600 to 650


def test_contract_overlaps_back_to_back_false():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False  # 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 660=11*60, touch at 600 shares no minute


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid_raises():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_time("not-a-time")


def test_contract_fmt_duration_padded():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65=60+5 -> 1h 05m
